avis.texte: I have combo skin and I also live in New England where the winters are harsh and the Summers are hot!!! I find that this works year round through any season. Its kept my skin hydrated without being greasy and kept it glowing without being oily. Its so good.

I have very dry skin, and this is a game changer for skin prep before makeup. I first use a milky toner and then I layer this conditioning milk on top before ending with sunscreen. I use 2-3 pumps for my face, and it does not pill. I do let it dry for 10 minutes before applying makeup. This is a VERY lightweight moisturizer. It will not work for dry skin on its own for an everyday moisturizer. That is not what it is for. This is for additional moisturizing needed.
Early 30s with combo skin. This did absolutely nothing for my skin. Texture is like watered down lotion, yes i know it states that this is a milky lotion. Will be using on my body just to use it up.

Hyped about Korean skincare products I decided to give this a try. I have normal clear sensitive fair middle aged skin and red hair. cons; I tried this for a week and a half and had the absolute worst cystic acne on parts of my face that normally are clear. Cystic acne that I have not seen since I was a teenager. Texture reminds me of a watered down J&J baby lotion. Despite it saying peach, it smells nothing like peaches pros; the pump bottle Guess I will use the rest to moisturize my hands, knees or feet.

avis.titre: Glad I decided to try out this product
avis.texte: I bought this product once my Medicube Collagen Jelly started getting low, and with tariffs I was looking for alternatives. I decided to use this product(I already use two other Anua products), and my face feels so soft after using it in the morning.

it's a bit thicker than the ilia milk mosturizer, super mosturizing. works as a final skincare step or layering with another mosturizer. is a decent primer for makeup too, and it doesn't pill with my sunscreen or makeup!
